name: Tooga's Quest
summary: Tooga, a lost turtle, was sent out to fetch dinner by his wife Torta and took a wrong turn somewhere. Tooga asks you to lead him back to Torta, who waits just south of Steamwheedle Port.

sections.title: A Lost Wanderer
sections.body: Tooga wanders near a crashed goblin zeppelin close to Thistleshrub Valley. Torta sent Tooga out to fetch dinner, and a wrong turn somewhere has left the turtle hopelessly lost. Tooga asks you to lead the way back.

sections.title: Across the Zone
sections.body: Torta waits just south of Steamwheedle Port, in the opposite corner of Tanaris, so the walk takes you across almost the whole width of the zone.

sections.title: A Wife's Welcome
sections.body: Torta is not surprised that Tooga could not find the way home alone, and tells Tooga to get into the ocean and bring back some food.

aliases: who is the turtle in tanaris
faq.answer: A lost turtle in Tanaris who needs help finding the way back to his wife.
Tooga's wife, who waits just south of Steamwheedle Port.

faq.q: Why is Tooga lost in the desert?
faq.answer: Torta sent Tooga to fetch dinner, and a wrong turn left him lost.
Near a crashed goblin zeppelin by Thistleshrub Valley in Tanaris.
